items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: We had a band together that time.

ctx.x: I want to ask you, how was Domenkis who played violin, how was he compared to Peter on and Dennis Dore, the old man Rocha?

He wasn't in their class, no. He was like a jazz violin player, something like Willie. That's all I was with Saeed, Willie Durner was. Playin' the thing he helped. He could read too, but I mean that'd be most of you and I could play that. The jazz violin. And Paul Delingrich. Yeah. That's when old man Piku was playin' with me and Johnny Deeb, I mean all that. We had a band together that time. We played the autographs at that time.
How was Piku to work with?
